Wikipedia: Mughal portraiture was “influenced by Western prints, which were available at the Mughal court”

highlight.text: From fairly early the Mughal style made a strong feature of realistic portraiture, normally in profile, and influenced by Western prints, which were available at the Mughal court.

source.label: Wikidata (San Diego Museum of Art record): gouache and gold on paper

work.text: More than any of his compatriots, Basawan studied and learned profoundly from the European prints that circulated in the Mughal empire, and consequently his figures are defined by weight and mass, and his character studies are unrivaled

source.author: Milo Cleveland Beach
source.title: The Imperial Image: Paintings for the Mughal Court
source.publisher: Freer Gallery of Art, Smithsonian Institution (Internet Archive scan)

moment.text: He showed great reverence for the pictures of our Savior and the blessed Virgin, and even for those of other saints; and he ordered his painter to make copies of those which the Fathers had placed in their chapel.
